terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.description: The rules for using this service.
terms.intro: These Terms govern your use of {company} (the "Service"). By creating an account or using the Service you agree to them. If you do not agree, do not use the Service.

sections.title: 1. Your account
body: You must provide accurate information and keep your sign-in methods (email, passkeys, Google) secure. You are responsible for activity under your account. Tell us at {email} if you suspect unauthorised access.
You must be old enough to enter a binding contract in your country, and at least 16 years old.

sections.title: 2. Acceptable use
body: Do not use the Service to break the law, infringe others' rights, send spam or malware, probe or disrupt the Service, or bypass rate limits and security measures.
You may only upload files you have the right to share. We may remove content or suspend accounts that breach these Terms.

sections.title: 3. Your content
body: You keep ownership of what you upload or create. You grant us a limited licence to host, process and display it solely to operate the Service for you.

sections.title: 4. Payments and subscriptions
body: Paid features are charged through our payment providers at the price shown at checkout. Subscriptions renew until cancelled; you can cancel at any time and keep access until the end of the paid period. Refunds follow the law of your country and any policy shown at checkout.
We do not store your card details; they are handled by the payment provider.

sections.title: 5. Availability and changes
body: We work to keep the Service available but do not guarantee uninterrupted operation. We may change or discontinue features, and will give reasonable notice of changes that significantly affect you.

sections.title: 6. Termination
body: You can delete your account at any time in Settings. We may suspend or close accounts that breach these Terms. On deletion your data is removed as described in the Privacy Policy.

sections.title: 7. Disclaimers and liability
body: The Service is provided "as is". To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect or consequential losses, and our total liability is limited to the amount you paid us in the 12 months before the claim. Nothing limits liability that cannot be limited by law.

sections.title: 8. Changes to these Terms
body: We may update these Terms. We will post the new version here and, for material changes, notify you. Continuing to use the Service after the change means you accept it.

sections.title: 9. Governing law and contact
body: These Terms are governed by the law of the country where {company} is established, and its courts have jurisdiction, without prejudice to mandatory consumer rights. Questions: {email}.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: What data we collect, why, and your rights.
privacy.intro: {company} ("we") respects your privacy. This policy explains what personal data the Service processes, why, and what you can do about it.

sections.title: 1. Data we collect
body: Account data: name, email address, profile picture (if you sign in with Google), and sign-in credentials such as passkey public keys. Sessions: a session token, IP address and browser/device description.

Content and activity: tasks, uploaded files, messages exchanged through connected channels (such as WhatsApp) and payment records (product, amount, status, provider references; never full card numbers).
Device data: push notification subscriptions you enable, and technical logs and error reports needed to run and secure the Service.

sections.title: 2. Why we use it (legal bases)
body: To provide the Service and perform our contract with you (account, sign-in, features, payments); to keep it secure and prevent abuse (legitimate interests); to send notifications you opted into (consent); and to comply with legal obligations such as accounting.

sections.title: 3. Cookies and local storage
body: We use only essential cookies and storage: the session cookie, your language (NEXT_LOCALE) and theme preferences, and a cookie that remembers you dismissed a prompt. We do not use advertising or cross-site tracking cookies, so no consent banner is needed. If you add analytics or marketing tools, update this section and ask for consent first.

sections.title: 4. Who we share data with
body: Service providers acting on our instructions: hosting and database, email delivery (e.g. Resend), payment processors (e.g. EPay, Dodo Payments), WhatsApp/Meta for messaging you use, object storage, error monitoring (e.g. Sentry) and Google if you choose Google sign-in. We do not sell personal data. We may disclose data when the law requires it.

sections.title: 5. International transfers
body: Some providers may process data outside your country or the EEA. Where required we rely on safeguards such as standard contractual clauses.

sections.title: 6. Retention
body: We keep account data while your account exists. Expired sessions and verification codes are deleted automatically; revoked push subscriptions after 30 days. When you delete your account, your profile, tasks, passkeys, subscriptions and uploaded files are deleted immediately. Backups are overwritten on their normal cycle. We may keep limited records required by law (for example tax or accounting records) for the legally required period.

sections.title: 7. Your rights
body: Depending on where you live (for example under the GDPR or the Brazilian LGPD) you can access, correct, export, restrict or object to the use of your data, withdraw consent, and complain to your data protection authority. You can edit your profile and delete your account in Settings; for anything else write to {email}. We reply within one month.

sections.title: 8. Security
body: We use encryption in transit, hashed one-time codes, rate limiting, restricted access and a Content Security Policy. No system is perfectly secure; tell us at {email} if you find a vulnerability.

sections.title: 9. Children
body: The Service is not directed to children under 16 and we do not knowingly collect their data.

sections.title: 10. Changes and contact
body: We will post updates on this page and, for material changes, notify you. Controller and contact: {company}, {email}.
